from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup layout
        title_text = "Prerequisite: The Language of Waves"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Light waves have both amplitude and phase properties.",
            "Interference happens when two light waves overlap.",
            "Aligned peaks create brightness, while opposing peaks cancel out."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        COLOR_WAVE = "#FFFFFF"
        COLOR_PEAK = "#FFFF00"
        COLOR_TROUGH = "#FF00FF"
        COLOR_INTERFERENCE = "#00FFFF"
        COLOR_DIM = "#666666"

        # Position Constants derived from Grid
        grid_b1 = self.grid["B1"]
        grid_b6 = self.grid["B6"]
        grid_e1 = self.grid["E1"]
        
        start_x = float(grid_b1[0])
        end_x = float(grid_b6[0])
        wave_width = end_x - start_x
        center_y = (float(grid_b1[1]) + float(grid_e1[1])) / 2.0
        
        # Dynamic Trackers
        phase_tracker = ValueTracker(0.0)
        amp_tracker = ValueTracker(0.8)
        
        def get_wave_points(p_val, a_val):
            num_steps = 100
            pts = []
            for i in range(num_steps + 1):
                pct = float(i) / num_steps
                x = start_x + pct * wave_width
                # Wave equation: y = center + amp * sin(freq * x - phase)
                # 2 full cycles across the area (4*PI)
                y = center_y + a_val * np.sin(4.0 * np.pi * pct - p_val)
                pts.append([x, y, 0.0])
            return pts

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # A white sine wave #FFFFFF oscillates horizontally.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(COLOR_WAVE)
        
        wave1 = VMobject(color=COLOR_WAVE)
        wave1.set_points_as_corners(get_wave_points(0.0, 0.8))
        wave1.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_points_as_corners(
            get_wave_points(phase_tracker.get_value(), amp_tracker.get_value())
        ))
        
        self.add(wave1)
        self.play(
            phase_tracker.animate.set_value(2.0 * np.pi), 
            run_time=3, 
            rate_func=linear
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # The peak of the wave flashes yellow #FFFF00 and the trough flashes magenta #FF00FF.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].set_color(COLOR_DIM),
            self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        )
        
        def get_peak_pos():
            p = phase_tracker.get_value()
            # sin(4*pi*pct - p) = 1 => 4*pi*pct - p = pi/2 => pct = (pi/2 + p) / (4*pi)
            pct = (np.pi / 2.0 + p) / (4.0 * np.pi)
            pct = pct % 0.5 # Period in pct is 0.5 (for 2 cycles total)
            return np.array([start_x + pct * wave_width, center_y + amp_tracker.get_value(), 0.0])

        def get_trough_pos():
            p = phase_tracker.get_value()
            # sin(4*pi*pct - p) = -1 => 4*pi*pct - p = 3*pi/2 => pct = (3*pi/2 + p) / (4*pi)
            pct = (3.0 * np.pi / 2.0 + p) / (4.0 * np.pi)
            pct = pct % 0.5
            return np.array([start_x + pct * wave_width, center_y - amp_tracker.get_value(), 0.0])

        peak_dot = Dot(color=COLOR_PEAK, radius=0.08)
        peak_dot.add_updater(lambda d: d.move_to(get_peak_pos()))
        
        trough_dot = Dot(color=COLOR_TROUGH, radius=0.08)
        trough_dot.add_updater(lambda d: d.move_to(get_trough_pos()))
        
        self.add(peak_dot, trough_dot)
        
        # Flash visual feedback
        self.play(
            Flash(get_peak_pos(), color=COLOR_PEAK, flash_radius=0.3),
            Flash(get_trough_pos(), color=COLOR_TROUGH, flash_radius=0.3),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        self.play(
            phase_tracker.animate.set_value(4.0 * np.pi), 
            run_time=3, 
            rate_func=linear
        )
        self.remove(peak_dot, trough_dot)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Two waves align their peaks, merging into a single wave with double the amplitude in cyan #00FFFF.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].set_color(COLOR_DIM),
            self.lecture[2].set_color(COLOR_INTERFERENCE)
        )
        
        # Create second wave in anti-phase (destructive interference initially)
        phase_tracker2 = ValueTracker(phase_tracker.get_value() + np.pi)
        wave2 = VMobject(color=WHITE, stroke_opacity=0.4)
        wave2.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_points_as_corners(
            get_wave_points(phase_tracker2.get_value(), 0.8)
        ))
        
        self.add(wave2)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Align the phases (Move to constructive interference)
        self.play(
            phase_tracker2.animate.set_value(phase_tracker.get_value()),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Merge: Fade out second wave and transform first into high-amplitude Cyan wave
        self.play(
            FadeOut(wave2),
            amp_tracker.animate.set_value(1.6),
            wave1.animate.set_color(COLOR_INTERFERENCE),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        # Final oscillation of the interference result
        self.play(
            phase_tracker.animate.set_value(6.0 * np.pi), 
            run_time=3, 
            rate_func=linear
        )
        self.wait(2)
